integrity: The exact ideal equality is replayed by a bundled standard-library checker over GF(2). The structural dimension and generic local multiplicity inputs are independently cited to the initiating paper. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only the affine four-variable cubic elementary symmetric polynomial over algebraically closed fields of characteristic 2; it does not classify general smaller-dimensional derivative or multiplicity loci.
title: Primary decomposition of the characteristic-two \(e_3\) critical scheme in four variables
